failure_modes.name: Query_Form_Mismatch
failure_modes.evidence: Both coordinator queries (hop 2 and hop 3) are formulated as natural-language yes/no questions: 'Did Kamal Haasan star in any films directed by K. Balachander, the director of "Sundara Swapnagalu"?' This is a yes/no question shape rather than a targeted entity or keyword query.

failure_modes.name: Query_Stagnation
failure_modes.evidence: The query at hop 2 ('Did Kamal Haasan star in any films directed by K. Balachander, the director of "Sundara Swapnagalu"?') is identical to the query at hop 3, showing exact repetition with no advancement between successive retrieval hops.

failure_modes.name: Repetitive_Output_Loop
failure_modes.evidence: After hop 1 solver concludes 'The claim is VERIFIED...The passages contain sufficient information to verify all components of the claim,' the hop 2 solver repeats 'The claim can be verified with the provided passages...All components of the claim...are directly supported by the passages provided,' and both coordinators then generate the identical query asking whether Kamal Haasan starred in films directed by K. Balachander despite verification already being complete. The agent restates the same conclusion across multiple hops without progressing toward task completion.
